summary: Preview backend confirmed to have the Paxity fix. Diagnostic returns base_url=https://transaction.paxity.io/api/v1, host=transaction.paxity.io, http_status=200, auth_test_status=200, response_preview contains 'SHOPPING EN CHINE'. Config returns configured=true, currency=XOF, 7 methods. All 3 validation error paths (unknown method / amount=0 / OMSN missing OTP) return 400 with French messages, without touching Paxity. NO live payin was executed.
action_items: Preview is correct — user can safely redeploy production to resolve the 401 'Identifiants refusés' issue on shopenchine.com.
seed_data_creation: None. All tests are read-only or validation-only (rejected before reaching Paxity).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Preview backend (paxity-payment-web.preview.emergentagent.com) is confirmed to run the fixed code with PAXITY_BASE_URL=https://transaction.paxity.io/api/v1 and returns 200 on /api/paxity/diagnostic. Production (shopenchine.com) still lags with old base URL until redeploy. Do NOT run any successful payin — each creates a real live transaction. iteration_5 already validated full happy path.
rca of the issue: Production 401 = deployment lag. Old prod code used PAXITY_BASE_URL=https://api.paxity.io/v1 (returns 401). Fix already in preview code+env: PAXITY_BASE_URL=https://transaction.paxity.io/api/v1 (returns 200 with valid live keys). Mitigation: redeploy preview to production.
